MR Safety
The Aster Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 12 T/m.
- Gradient slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s (per axis).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg.
- head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 10 min.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
